classPassive.name: Alchemist Potion
descriptions:
Allows using Alchemical Utensils. You gain 1 potion every 1.5s, up to a maximum of 8.
Right click while holding an Alchemist's Bag and not sneaking to throw a Brutal potion, which deals 100% of your base potion's damage as magic damage, to enemies near the point of impact.
Left click while holding an Alchemist's Bag and not sneaking to throw a Gruesome potion, which deals 80% of your base potion's damage as magic damage, and applies 5% slowness, 5% vulnerability, and 5% weakness to affected mobs, for 8s.

skills.name: Gruesome Alchemy
skills.simpleDescription: Throw potions that deal less damage, but apply slowness, weakness, and vulnerability to enemies.
descriptions: Your Gruesome Alchemist's Potions now apply 15% slow, 15% vulnerability, and 10% weaken for 8s.
The slow is increased to 25% and the vulnerability is increased to 25%.

Each time you hit non-boss mobs afflicted by your Gruesome Alchemist's Potions with your more powerful abilities (Alchemical Artillery, Unstable Amalgam, Volatile Reaction, Panacea, Transmutation Ring, or Esoteric Enhancements), they are stunned for 0.5s. Elites are Staggered instead (Stagger: same as Stun, but spells are only paused instead of cancelled).

skills.name: Brutal Alchemy
skills.simpleDescription: Throw potions that apply a magic damage over time effect to enemies.
descriptions: Your Brutal Alchemist's Potions now apply a DoT effect which does 1 + 10% of your potion's damage as magic damage every second, over 3s. Hitting an enemy afflicted by this DoT refreshes its duration and increases its potency by 0.5 + 5% of your potion's damage. Refreshing the DoT 3 times causes it to explode, instantly dealing its remaining damage, plus an additional 50% of your potion's damage, and clearing the effect.
Refreshing the DoT now increases its potency by 1 + 10% of your potion's damage. The additional damage from the explosion is now 65% of your potion's damage.

Hitting enemies afflicted by the DoT with your more powerful abilities (Alchemical Artillery, Unstable Amalgam, Volatile Reaction, Panacea, Transmutation Ring, or Esoteric Enhancements) makes them instantly take 1 additional tick of the DoT's damage.

skills.name: Iron Tincture
skills.simpleDescription: Throw a potion on the ground that you or other players can collect to gain absorption hearts.
descriptions: Right click while sneaking to throw a tincture. If you walk over the tincture, gain 4 stacking absorption health for 40 seconds. If an ally walks over it, you both gain the effect. If it isn't grabbed before it disappears, it will refund you a charge. When another player grabs the tincture, you gain 2 Alchemist's Potions. When you grab the tincture, you gain 1 Alchemist's Potion. Charges: 2 (all charges are refunded when the skill comes off cooldown). Cooldown: 40s.
The absorption is increased to 6. The tincture now also grants 10% resistance to the first hit taken. Cooldown: 35s.

The tincture now stuns non-elite, non-boss mobs within 3 blocks of its landing location, or the location of the player that picks it up before it lands, for 0.5s. If a player kills the affected mobs within 5s, they gain 1 absorption health for each kill, up to a maximum of 4 for level 1, and 6 for level 2, which lasts for 20s. However, if the tincture disappears, it will no longer refund you a charge.

skills.name: Alchemical Artillery
skills.simpleDescription: Launch a bomb in the direction you're looking, which damages mobs on impact and applies your Brutal potion's effects.
descriptions: Press key.drop while holding an Alchemist's Bag and not sneaking to launch a heavy bomb at the cost of 2 potions, which inherits 100% of your potion's velocity, and explodes on contact with the ground, lava, any mob, or after 6 seconds, dealing 5 + 115% of your potion's damage and applying Brutal, in an area that is 150% of your potion's radius. The initial speed of the bomb scales with your projectile speed. Cooldown: 6s.
The bomb's damage is increased to 6 + 130% of your potion's damage, its radius is increased to 175% of your potion's radius, and it now applies Brutal twice.

The bomb now bounces on collision with terrain, up to a maximum of 2 times. With the first bounce, it gains 2 + 80% of your potion's damage, and for each subsequent one it gains 50% as much as the previous one.

skills.name: Volatile Reaction
skills.simpleDescription: Prime enemies to be detonated by afflicting them with Brutal and Gruesome potions.
descriptions:
Press key.swapOffhand while holding an Alchemist's Bag and not sneaking to consume a potion and throw a Volatile Concoction with 150% radius which deals no damage, but marks all hit mobs as Volatile. When Volatile mobs gain either Gruesome or Brutal effects, they explode, taking 50% of your potion's damage, and dealing 10% of your potion's damage within a 3 block radius, spreading the Gruesome or Brutal effect they were hit with. Additionally, the potency of the effect applied to the Volatile mobs is increased by one level.  Cooldown: 15s.
Brutal Alchemy level 3 effect:
Refreshing the DoT now increases its potency by 1.5 + 15% of your potion's damage. The additional damage from the explosion is now 80% of your potion's damage.
Gruesome Alchemy level 3 effect:
The slow is increased to 35%, the vulnerability is increased to 35%, and the weakness is increased to 20%.
Volatile mobs hit with both Gruesome and Brutal effects now explode for a second time. The main damage of both explosions is increased to 60% of your potion's damage.

Volatile mobs hit with both Gruesome and Brutal effects now spread a DoT with stacking potency to the enemy with the highest remaining health within 5 blocks (capped at 5 stacks). The DoT has a base delay of 1.5s between each tick. For each stack, it ticks an additional 3 times, deals 15% more of your potion's damage, and has the tick delay reduced by 0.25s.

skills.name: Unstable Amalgam
skills.simpleDescription: Summon a ticking bomb that launches mobs (and players, if enabled) in the air, refunding you potions.
descriptions: Left click while holding an Alchemist's Bag and sneaking to consume a potion to place an Amalgam with 1 health at the location you are looking, up to 7 blocks away. When killed, or after 1s, it detonates, dealing your Alchemist Potion's damage + 10 magic damage to mobs within 4 blocks and applying both Gruesome and Brutal potion effects. Mobs and players in the radius are knocked away from the Amalgam. For each mob damaged, gain an Alchemist's Potion. Cooldown: 18s.
The damage is increased to 15. Cooldown: 14s.

Enemies hit by the Amalgam's explosion become unstable for 8 seconds, and they are knocked straight up. When an unstable mob is killed, a potion that deals 40% of your potion damage is dropped at its location. These potions apply both Brutal and Gruesome, and bypass both normal and Alchemist Potion iframes.

skills.name: Energizing Elixir
skills.simpleDescription: Splash potions on yourself and allies to grant buffs.
descriptions: Your potions now leave a faint 5 block high cloud, with 125% of your potion's radius, that lingers for 1s. Immediately, and every 0.5s, standing in the cloud gives you +15% speed and Jump Boost II for 8s.
The cloud now buffs allies within it with +15% damage dealt for 8s, refreshing on each application.

Clouds formed with your Brutal potions now grant allies within them 1 absorption health for 4s, up to a maximum of 2 absorption health, while clouds formed with your Gruesome potions now reduce the duration of all debuffs afflicting allies within them by 1s.

skills.name: Bezoar
skills.simpleDescription: Every few mobs that are killed nearby, spawn an item that can be picked up for damage and healing buffs.
descriptions: Every 5 mobs killed within 16 blocks of the Alchemist spawns a Bezoar that lingers for 10s. Picking up a Bezoar will grant the Alchemist an additional Alchemist Potion, and will grant both the player who picks it up and the Alchemist a custom healing effect that regenerates 5% of max health every second for 2s and reduces the duration of all your vanilla potion debuffs by 10s.
The Bezoar now additionally grants 15% damage from all sources for 8s.
Every 5 bezoars spawned, summon a Philosopher's Stone instead. Picking it up grants you +100% potion recharge rate for 8s and 4 absorption health for 12s.

specSkills.name: Taboo
specSkills.simpleDescription: Sacrifice health in exchange for increased magic damage.
descriptions: Press key.swapOffhand while sneaking to undergo a Taboo transformation, which lasts until deactivated. While transformed, you deal 30% more magic damage, gain 50% knockback resistance, and gain +50% potion recharge rate. However, you lose 2.5% of your health every second, which bypasses resistances and absorption, but cannot kill you. When this happens, the health loss increases by 0.6%. If the health loss reaches 10%, you also start losing 10% of your max health in absorption. Cooldown: 10s.
The magic damage bonus is increased to 40%. Deactivating Taboo now gives you 1 absorption health (max of 10) for every 10% of health missing, lasting for 8s.

specSkills.name: Scorched Earth
specSkills.simpleDescription: Deploy a circular zone in which your potions break into fragments that Scorch enemies.
descriptions:
Throw an Alchemist's Potion while sneaking to deploy a 6 block radius zone that lasts for 10s where the potion lands. While active, all mobs inside the zone are afflicted with 25% slowness and 10% weakness. Additionally, all mobs that enter it for the first time are Scorched for 2s. Splashing your Alchemist's Potions within an active zone makes them break into 3 fragments, which quickly fall back to the ground, each Scorching enemies within 2.5 blocks of the impact location (scales with your potion's radius) for 1s. Charges: 2 (all are refunded when the cooldown ends). Cooldown: 30s.
Scorched:
Scorched enemies take 40% of your potion's damage over 1s, and are set on fire. The duration of this debuff can stack up to a maximum of 5s, and it is gradually consumed over time.
Mobs inside the zone are now afflicted with 35% slowness and 15% weakness. The damage of the Scorched debuff is increased to 50% of your potion's damage over 1s.

specSkills.name: Esoteric Enhancements
specSkills.simpleDescription: Stack the effects of your Gruesome and Brutal potions on an enemy to summon a friendly creeper.
descriptions: When splashing the ground with both Gruesome and Brutal effects within 1.5 seconds of each other, summon an Alchemical Aberration. The Aberration targets the mob with the highest health within 8 blocks and explodes on that mob, dealing 7 + 90% of your potion damage and applying 35% Slow for 4 seconds, and Level 1 Brutal to all mobs within 4 blocks. The aberration expires after 15s. Cooldown: 5s.
Damage is increased to 8 + 125% of your potion damage, and the level of Brutal applied is increased to 2.

specSkills.name: Panacea
specSkills.simpleDescription: Launch a slow moving projectile that inflicts Gruesome and Brutal effects to mobs hit, and shields allies.
descriptions: Press key.drop while holding an Alchemist's Bag and sneaking to shoot a mixture that deals 135% of your potion's damage, applies 100% slow for 1.5s, and applies Level 1 Gruesome to mobs that are not already affected by it, or Level 1 Brutal otherwise. The mixture lowers the duration of all your vanilla potion debuffs by 5s. All hit allies also receive this effect, and are granted 2 absorption health (max of 16) for 16s. If the mixture hits a mob, all players within 6 blocks of it are granted 1 absorption health (max of 16) for 16s, up to a maximum of 6 mobs. After hitting a block or traveling 16 blocks, the mixture returns to you, and is able to damage mobs and shield allies a second time. Cooldown: 12s.
The level of Gruesome and Brutal inflicted is increased to 2. The absorption health granted to hit allies is increased to 4, and the slow duration is increased to 2s.

specSkills.name: Transmutation Ring
specSkills.simpleDescription: Deploy a circular zone that buffs the damage dealt by allies, and explodes upon expiring.
descriptions: Throw an Alchemist's Potion while sneaking to create an unstable Transmutation Ring at the potion's landing location. The ring lasts for 8 seconds and has a radius of 6 blocks. While active, all players within the ring deal 15% extra damage on all attacks. For each mob that dies within the ring, it gains a stack of instability, or two if it was an Elite, up to a maximum of 3. Upon expiring or reaching maximum instability, the ring explodes, dealing 3 + 30% of your potion's damage per stack to each mob still inside it. It also grants the remaining duration of its damage buff, plus 5s extra if it had reached max stacks, to all players inside. Cooldown: 15s.
Each stack of instability gained now refunds you 1 Alchemist's Potion. Additionally, all players caught inside the explosion now gain 2 absorption health for 8s for each stack of instability.

specSkills.name: Warding Remedy
specSkills.simpleDescription: Periodically grant absorption to you and nearby allies, for a short period of time.
descriptions: Press key.swapOffhand while sneaking to give players (including yourself) within 12 blocks 1 absorption health every 0.5 seconds for 4 seconds, lasting 30 seconds, up to 6 absorption health. Cooldown: 30s.
You and allies within 12 blocks passively gain 10% resistance while having absorption health. Cooldown: 25s.
After being damaged or debuffed by an ability, any mob will be treated as a Heretic by your abilities for 10 seconds.

skills.name: Celestial Blessing
skills.simpleDescription: Grant yourself and nearby players speed and increased damage.
descriptions: Left click while sneaking to grant all players within 12 blocks 20% damage and 20% speed for 15 seconds. Dealing damage affected by this effect triggers Crusade's target marking. Cooldown: 35s.
The damage buff is increased to 30%.
Celestial Blessing can be extended by 5 seconds by performing a fully-charged melee attack, critical projectile attack, and ability hit on any enemy during its duration.

skills.name: Cleansing Rain
skills.simpleDescription: Summon a rain cloud that cleanses debuffs, healing and granting resistance to players below it.
descriptions: Right click while sneaking and looking up to summon a Cleansing Rain that follows you, removing all negative effects shorter than 30 seconds from players within 4 blocks, including yourself, and lasts for 6 seconds. Players heal 10% of their max health the first time a given debuff is cleansed, up to 3 unique debuffs. Cooldown: 25s.
Additionally grants 20% resistance to players while under the rain. Duration is increased to 10 seconds.
The radius is increased to 6 blocks, and each player touched by the rain keeps its effect for the cast duration.

skills.name: Divine Justice
skills.simpleDescription: Deal extra damage on critical melee or projectile attacks against Heretics, and heal yourself and nearby players when killing them.
descriptions: Critical melee or projectile attacks deal 2 plus 15% of your base critical damage as magic damage to Heretics.

The damage is increased to 3 + 30% of your base critical damage. Additionally, whenever you kill a Heretic, you and players within 12 blocks of you regenerate 5% of their max health over 1 second. Duration stacks on kill up to 3 seconds.
After triggering Divine Justice 3 times within 5 seconds of each other, all your other damaging abilities deal 20% more damage for the next 2 seconds.

skills.name: Hand of Light
skills.simpleDescription: Heal all players in front of the Cleric, and damage all mobs based on the number of Heretics in the area.
descriptions: Right click while sneaking to heal all other players in a 12 block cone in front of you or within 2 blocks of you for 4 health + 10% of their max health, and give them Regeneration II for 4 seconds. Additionally, if there is at least one Heretic in the area, damage all mobs in the area with magic damage equal to 3 + 2 * the number of Heretics in the range, up to 5 mobs. Cooldown: 14s.
The healing is improved to 6 health + 15% of their max health. Damage is increased to 4 + 3 * the number of Heretics in the range, up to 4 mobs. Cooldown: 10s.

The cone is changed to a sphere of equal range, centered on the Cleric. The cooldown is reduced by 2.5% for each 4 health healed, capped at 50% cooldown. All Heretics caught in the radius are stunned for 0.5 seconds.

skills.name: Heavenly Boon
skills.simpleDescription: Share all positive splash potion effects with nearby players and occasionally generate splash potions when killing Heretics.
descriptions: Whenever you are hit with a positive splash potion, the effects are also given to other players within 12 blocks. In addition, whenever a Heretic you have hit within 1.5 seconds dies or you deal enough non-true damage to a boss (R1 100/R2 200/R3 300), you have a 20% chance to be splashed with a 20% Instant Health potion, with an additional effect of either Regeneration I, 10% strength, 10% resistance, 20% speed, or 20% absorption with a 20 second duration. Cooldown: 8s.
Boon generated potions now give 50 second effect duration. Cooldown: 6s.
When a potion is created by this skill, decrease all other ability cooldowns of all players in the radius by 5% (max 1 seconds).

skills.name: Touch of Radiance
skills.simpleDescription: Link with a player or a Heretic to speed up your cooldown recharge rate and weaken enemies.
descriptions: Press key.drop while sneaking and  while looking at another player or a Heretic within 16 blocks to gain 50% faster cooldown recharge rate for all other abilities for the next 6 seconds. If looking at a player, they gain the same buff. If looking at a Heretic, it is stunned for 1.5 seconds. Players are prioritized when searching for a target. Cooldown: 30s.
Cooldown recharge rate is increased to 75%. Additionally, all mobs within a 3.5 block radius of the target are inflicted with 20% weakness for 7 seconds.

After killing a targeted mob, your next attack on a Heretic deals 9 magic damage to it and stuns it for 0.5 seconds. That mob becomes the new target, and killing it grants the same effect, repeating until Touch of Radiance runs out. If the first target was a player, the effect is primed for both of you immediately.

skills.name: Illuminate
skills.simpleDescription: Fire an explosive projectile forwards while leaving behind a trail that buffs allies.
descriptions: Press key.drop to fire a holy projectile that travels for 24 blocks, leaving behind a 3.5 block wide trail that lasts for 6 seconds and grants 20% speed to all players inside it. Buffs linger for 4 seconds upon leaving the area. Upon hitting a mob, block, or reaching its max distance, the projectile explodes, dealing 11 magic damage to mobs within 4.5 blocks and knocking them away. Cooldown: 14s.
The damage is increased to 15, and the trail's duration is increased to 8 seconds. Additionally, players within the trail also gain 10% strength. Cooldown: 12s.

A sanctified area is placed wherever Illuminate explodes, granting the same effects as the trail within a 6 block radius and lasting for the same duration. Enemies within Illuminate's trail take 1 magic damage every 0.5 seconds.

skills.name: Sanctified Armor
skills.simpleDescription: Taking large damage grants you temporary resistance and applies slowness to Heretics that hit you.
descriptions: When taking damage that leaves you at 40% of your max health or lower, or taking 40% of your max health or more damage within 1 second, sanctify your armor for the next 7 seconds. While sanctified, you gain 20% resistance and 50% knockback resistance, and you knock away and apply 15% slowness for 4 seconds to any Heretic that hits you with a melee or projectile attack in the duration. Cooldown: 25s.
Resistance is increased to 30%, and slowness is increased to 25%. Killing an Elite while Sanctified Armor is active extends its duration by 2 seconds.
If the most recently slowed mob is killed while active, regain half the health lost from the last damage taken.
Divine Justice's % multiplier is increased by 10%, and you gain 8% Knockback Resistance (up to 40%) for every Heretic within 8 blocks of you.

specSkills.name: Holy Javelin
specSkills.simpleDescription: Throw a piercing spear of light that ignites and damages mobs.
descriptions: Left click while sprinting to throw a piercing spear of light 0.95 blocks wide, instantly travelling up to 12 blocks or until it hits a solid block. It deals 24 magic damage to all Heretics along its path, and 12 magic damage to non-Heretics, and sets them all on fire for 5 seconds. Attacking a Heretic while triggering, whether critical or not, transmits Divine Justice damage to all enemies pierced by the spear. Cooldown: 9s.

The range is increased to 16 blocks. Additionally, if there are no mobs in the spear's path, launch yourself forward with it. You can only launch yourself once before touching the ground again. Cooldown: 8s.

specSkills.name: Choir Bells
specSkills.simpleDescription: Taunt, slow, and apply vulnerability to nearby mobs.
descriptions: Press key.swapOffhand while sneaking to afflict all enemies within 10 blocks with 10% slowness for 8 seconds. Heretics are taunted, dealt 8 magic damage, and are afflicted with 30% vulnerability and 20% weakness for 8 seconds. Cooldown: 16s.

After casting, the bells will toll 2 more times at the casting location, at a rate of every 3 seconds. The extra tolls apply 10% slowness to all mobs and 20% vulnerability and 3 magic damage to Heretics in its 10 block radius for 3 seconds, taunting them as well.

specSkills.name: Luminous Infusion
specSkills.simpleDescription: Upon activating, your next attack on a Heretic causes an explosion.
descriptions: Press key.swapOffhand while not sneaking to charge your hands with holy light. The next attack or ability you perform against a Heretic causes a 4 block radius explosion that deals R2: 16 / R3: 22 magic damage to it and other Heretics or R2: 8 / R3: 11 damage to non-Heretics. Enemies are knocked away from the hit Heretic. 2 charges. Having multiple charges primed at once will cause one explosion at a time, and all charges are replenished when cooldown expires. Cooldown: 18s.
Max charges increased to 3. Mobs hit by an explosion are set on fire for 3 seconds.
Divine Justice's % multiplier is increased by 10%, and you and other players within 12 blocks heal 5% of max health every 3 seconds while under 50% health.

specSkills.name: Ethereal Ascension
specSkills.simpleDescription: Take flight temporarily and convert your projectiles into magical orbs that damage mobs and buff players.
descriptions: Press key.swapOffhand while sneaking to Ascend and hover above the ground for 12s. While Ascended, projectiles you shoot turn into orbs that move in a straight line, applying aspect enchants and dealing up to 4 + 85% of your base projectile damage when fully charged, including flat damage buffs, as magic damage to mobs in a 2 block radius on impact. A mob can only be hit by one orb every 0.4s. Hitting allies with an orb grants them a 30% damage bonus and Haste II for 8s. Double-jumping will cause you to dash forward, at most once every 2s. Ascension ends and goes on cooldown when the duration expires or you recast the ability. Cooldown: 25s.

You gain 15% increased orb radius from fully charged bow and crossbow shots, and 10% faster throw rate while Ascended. For each mob you kill while Ascended, extend the duration by 0.5s, up to a total of 4 extra seconds.

specSkills.name: Hallowed Beam
specSkills.simpleDescription: Heal a targeted player, damage a targeted Heretic, or stun a targeted non-Heretic from a distance.
descriptions: Left click while holding a projectile weapon, not sneaking, and looking directly at a player or mob within 30 blocks to shoot a beam of light. If aimed at a player, the beam instantly heals them for 30% of their max health, knocking back enemies within 4 blocks. If aimed at a Heretic, it instantly deals R2: 26 / R3: 40 magic damage to them, applies aspect enchants, and stuns them for 1s. If aimed at a non-Heretic mob, it instantly stuns them for 2s and applies aspect enchants. This skill can only apply Recoil once before touching the ground. Charges: 3. Cooldown: 10s.

Players healed are now also granted 10% resistance for 5 seconds. Mobs affected are marked by a Holy Seal for 5 seconds - the next melee attack, projectile or Ethereal Ascension orb to damage them by any player will explode the Seal, dealing R2: 9 / R3: 12 magic damage in a 3 block radius. If the beam kills the mob, the Seal is instead transferred to the nearest mob within 4 blocks.

specSkills.name: Keeper Virtue
specSkills.simpleDescription: An angelic spirit follows you, supporting nearby players and attacking Heretics but losing health in the process.
descriptions: Passively have a Virtue with 30 health follow you, and while inactive it regenerates 1 health every 0.5s and grants you 15% speed. You can heal it with Hallowed Beam at any time. Press key.swapOffhand while not sneaking to toggle it active, making it seek out players within 16 blocks under 60% health, healing them for 5% of their max health every 0.5s at least 5 times and until they're up to 70% or higher, draining 2 of its health per heal. If no players are found, it instead seeks out Heretics, dealing R2: 7 / R3: 10 magic damage to them and draining 2 health every 1.25s. The Virtue regenerates half as much while active with no target. If the Virtue dies, it respawns after 20s.
The Virtue now has 35 health. The speed bonus when inactive is now granted to all players in a 9 block radius around you. Mobs attacked by the Virtue are inflicted with 15% vulnerability for 4s.
Your spell damage is increased by your wand's Spell Power stat. After casting a spell, your next melee attack with a wand deals 20% more damage.

skills.name: Arcane Strike
skills.simpleDescription: Attack an enemy with a wand to damage nearby mobs.
descriptions: When you attack an enemy with a wand, you unleash an arcane explosion dealing 4 + 10% of your wand's base damage as arcane magic damage to all mobs within 4 blocks around the target. Enemies that are on fire or slowed take 2 extra damage. Arcane Strike can not trigger Spellshock's static. Cooldown: 5s.
The damage is increased to 7 + 20% of your wand's base damage. Mobs that are on fire or slowed take 3 additional damage.

The damage is increased by 15%. Your enchantment on-hit effects are now also applied to all other enemies hit in the radius. Additionally, apply a 20% weaken effect to the hit mob that lasts for 8 seconds and applies to melee, projectile, magic, blast, and fire damage.

skills.name: Elemental Arrows
skills.simpleDescription: Shoot fire and ice projectiles that deal magic damage.
descriptions: Your fully drawn projectiles are set on fire. If sneaking, shoot an ice arrow instead, afflicting the target with 20% slowness for 6 seconds. Projectiles shot this way are magically infused, scaling off of magic damage instead of projectile damage. Ice arrows deal 8 extra damage to Blazes. Fire arrows deal 8 extra damage to strays. This skill can not apply Spellshock.
Your Elemental Arrows deal 20% of the damage to mobs within 3 blocks and apply effects.
Your next elemental arrow also stuns enemies hit for 1 seconds and deals 50% more damage. Cooldown: 8s.

skills.name: Frost Nova
skills.simpleDescription: Damage and slow nearby mobs.
descriptions: Left click while holding a wand and sneaking to unleash a frost nova, dealing 5 ice magic damage to enemies within 7 blocks around you, afflicting them with 20% slowness for 4 seconds, and extinguishing them if they're on fire. Slowness is reduced by 10% on elites and bosses, and all players in the nova are also extinguished. Cooldown: 18s.
Damage is increased to 10 and base slowness is increased to 40%. Cooldown: 16s.
Damage is increased by 15%. Non elites and bosses are frozen for 2 seconds, having their AI and gravity removed and gain 100% Anti-Heal. Cooldown is further reduced by 1 second.

skills.name: Magma Shield
skills.simpleDescription: Damage and ignite mobs in a cone.
descriptions: Right click while holding a wand and sneaking to summon a torrent of flames, dealing 6 fire magic damage to all enemies in front of you within 7 blocks, setting them on fire for 6 seconds, and knocking them away. Cooldown: 12s.
Damage is increased to 12.

Magma Shield now has two charges. All charge stacks are consumed at once on use, per additional charge over 1 consumed: deal 3 extra damage, deal 50% extra damage from fire/inferno ticks and deal 20% extra damage from fire abilities for 6 seconds. Cooldown: 8s.

skills.name: Mana Lance
skills.simpleDescription: Shoot a beam that damages mobs in its path.
descriptions: Right click while holding a wand and not sneaking to fire forth a piercing beam of Mana going 8 blocks, dealing 6 arcane magic damage to enemies in the path of the beam. This beam will not go through solid blocks. Cooldown: 5s.
The damage is increased to 7. Cooldown: 3s.
Mana Lance now has two charges.

skills.name: Spellshock
skills.simpleDescription: Deal extra damage to nearby enemies when damaging an enemy recently damaged by a spell.
descriptions: Hitting an enemy with a spell inflicts Static for 6 seconds. Hitting an enemy inflicted with Static triggers a spellshock centered on the enemy that deals 20% of the triggering spell's damage to all enemies within 3 blocks. Spellshocks can cause chain reactions on enemies with Static, but an enemy can only be hit by a spellshock once per tick. If a Static enemy is hit by a Melee attack, the hit gains 10% melee damage, the enemy receives 30% slowness for 0.5 seconds, and the Static dissipates.
Spellshocks deal 30% of the triggering spell's damage and melee attacks gain 15% melee damage. Additionally, gain 20% speed for 6 seconds whenever a spellshock is triggered.

Hitting an enemy inflicted with Static with certain spell types grants additional effects or applies additional debuffs. Arcane spells apply a magic DoT, dealing 1.5 damage per second for 3 seconds. Fire spells gain 20% magic damage, enemies hit by Ice spells receive 15% slowness and 10% vulnerability for 3 seconds, and enemies hit by Lightning spells deal 3 damage to a random mob within 7 blocks, prioritizing Elites and Bosses. All damage dealt by this Enhancement will not trigger nor apply Static, and is scaled by Spell Power

skills.name: Thunder Step
skills.simpleDescription: Teleport forward, damaging mobs at the origin and destination.
descriptions: Press key.drop while holding a wand to materialize a flash of thunder, dealing 5 thunder magic damage to all enemies within 4 blocks around you. The next moment, you teleport in the direction you're looking, travelling up to 8 blocks or until you hit a solid block, and repeat the thunder attack at your destination. Cooldown: 20s.
Damage is increased to 8 and teleport range is increased to 10 blocks.

Within 3 seconds of casting, trigger again to return to the original starting location, dealing 20% of the skill's damage. If you do not do so, your next Thunder Step within 30 seconds will paralyze enemies for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Prismatic Shield
skills.simpleDescription: When health drops below a threshold, gain absorption.
descriptions: When you drop below 6 health, you receive 4 absorption health which lasts up to 12 seconds. If damage taken would kill you but could have been prevented by up to 4 times this skill's absorption, it will save you from death. In addition, enemies within 4 blocks are knocked back. Cooldown: 90s.
The shield is improved to 8 absorption health. Knocked back enemies are stunned for 1 second.

After Prismatic Shield is activated, in the next 5 seconds, you deal 25% more damage and every spell that deals damage to at least one enemy will heal you for 5% of your max health. Additionally, your abilities' cooldowns are reduced by 5 seconds.

specSkills.name: Astral Omen
specSkills.simpleDescription: Upon damaging a mob with multiple types of magic, deal damage to nearby mobs.
descriptions: Dealing spell damage to an enemy marks its fate, giving it an omen based on the spell type (Arcane, Fire, Ice, Thunder). If an enemy hits 2 omens of different types, its fate is sealed, clearing its omens and causing a magical implosion, dealing 7 magic damage to it and all enemies within 3 blocks. An enemy loses all its omens after 10 seconds of it not gaining another omen. That implosion's damage cannot apply omens. Omens cannot be applied or sealed by Elemental Arrows.
The implosion now pulls all enemies inwards and deals 7.5 damage. Enemies hit by the implosion now take 15% more damage from you for 8 seconds.

specSkills.name: Cosmic Moonblade
specSkills.simpleDescription: Damage mobs in a cone twice and reduce cooldowns if mobs are damaged.
descriptions: Press key.swapOffhand while holding a wand and not sneaking to cause a wave of arcane blades to hit every enemy within a 5 block cone 2 times in rapid succession. Each slash deals 5 arcane magic damage and reduces all your other skill cooldowns by 5% (Max 0.5 seconds) if it hits at least one mob. Cooldown: 8s.

Cooldown reduction is increased to 10% (Max 1 second) per blade and damage is increased to 7. Additionally reduce all cooldowns including Cosmic Moonblade by 7.5% (Max 0.75 seconds) if this ability killed a mob once per activation.

specSkills.name: Sage's Insight
specSkills.simpleDescription: Refresh a spell's cooldown after multiple spells damage enemies in succession.
descriptions: If an active spell hits an enemy, you gain an Arcane Insight. Insights stack up to 8, but decay every 4 seconds of not gaining one. Once 8 Insights are revealed, the cooldowns of the previous 2 spells cast are refreshed. This sets your Insights back to 0.
Sage's Insight now refreshes the cooldowns of your previous 3 spells upon activating.

specSkills.name: Blizzard
specSkills.simpleDescription: For a period of time, slightly damage and slow nearby mobs.
descriptions: Right click while holding a wand, sneaking, and looking up to create a storm of ice and snow that follows the player, dealing 3 ice magic damage every second to all enemies within 7 blocks of you. The blizzard lasts for 10 seconds, and chills enemies within it, slowing them by 25%. Players in the blizzard are extinguished if they are on fire. This ability does not interact with Spellshock. Cooldown: 30s.
Damage is increased to 5, aura size is increased to 10 blocks, and slowness is increased to 30%.

specSkills.name: Fire Elemental Spirit
specSkills.simpleDescription: Deal extra damage in a radius upon dealing fire or ice damage.
descriptions: Two spirits accompany you - one of fire and one of ice. The next moment after you deal fire damage, the fire spirit instantly dashes from you towards the farthest enemy that spell hit, dealing 10 fire magic damage to all enemies within 1.5 blocks around it along its path. The next moment after you deal ice damage, the ice spirit warps to the closest enemy that spell hit and induces an extreme local climate, dealing 4 ice magic damage to all enemies within 3 blocks around it every second for 3 seconds. If the spell was Elemental Arrows, the fire spirit does an additional 25% of the projectile weapon's original damage, and for the ice spirit, an additional 10%. Independent Cooldown: 8s.
Fire spirit damage is increased to 15. Ice spirit damage is increased to 6. The Elemental Arrows projectile damage multiplier is increased to 40% for the fire spirit and 15% for the ice spirit.

specSkills.name: Starfall
specSkills.simpleDescription: Summon a meteor, which upon impact damages and ignites mobs.
descriptions: Press key.swapOffhand while holding a wand and not sneaking to mark where you're looking, up to 25 blocks away. You summon a falling meteor above the mark that lands strongly, dealing 15 fire magic damage to all enemies within 6 blocks around it, setting them on fire for 5s , and knocking them away. Cooldown: 18s.
Damage is increased to 27.
While holding two swords, you deal 30% more melee damage to Elites and 15% more melee damage to Bosses.

skills.name: Advancing Shadows
skills.simpleDescription: Teleport to a mob and gain a damage bonus.
descriptions: Right click while holding two swords and not sneaking to teleport to the target hostile enemy within 11 blocks and gain 30% melee damage for 5 seconds. Cooldown: 20s.
Damage increased to 40% melee damage, teleport range is increased to 16 blocks, and all hostile non-target mobs within 4 blocks are knocked away from the target.
If the mob you teleported to dies within 1 second, you can recast Advancing Shadows again in the next 4 seconds. Recasts provide 50% of the damage bonus and do not provide Deadly Ronde stacks.

skills.name: By My Blade
skills.simpleDescription: Critical melee hits periodically do more damage and give Attack Speed.
descriptions: While holding two swords, performing a critical melee attack deals 12 melee damage to the hit enemy and grants Haste II for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 10s.
The damage is increased to 24 and additionally gain 20% attack speed for 4 seconds.
By My Blade does 20% extra damage. Killing an enemy with this ability heals you for 5% of your max health which is increased to 15% if the target was an Elite or Boss mob.

skills.name: Dagger Throw
skills.simpleDescription: Throw daggers that deal damage and apply vulnerability.
descriptions: Left click while holding two swords and sneaking to throw 3 daggers which deal 4 melee damage and apply 20% vulnerability for 10 seconds. The daggers travel up to 8 blocks. Cooldown: 12s.
The damage is increased to 8 and the vulnerability is increased to 40%.

Your daggers will remain stationary at the end of their path. After 5 seconds, your daggers will be recalled, or you can recast to trigger the recall early. Recalled daggers do 80% of the damage. Your Dagger Throw additionally silences mobs for 2 seconds.

skills.name: Dodging
skills.simpleDescription: Dodge a projectile that would otherwise hit you.
descriptions: Block an arrow, thrown potion, blaze fireball, or snowball that would have hit you. Cooldown: 12s.
When this ability is triggered, you gain 20% speed for 15 seconds. Cooldown: 10s.
Gain a secondary independent cooldown to block a magic attack that would otherwise have hit you. The cooldown is 250% of your cooldown for Dodging.

skills.name: Escape Death
skills.simpleDescription: When health drops below a threshold, stun nearby mobs.
descriptions: When taking damage leaves you below 10 health, throw a paralyzing grenade that stuns all mobs within 5 blocks for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 60s.

When this ability is triggered, you gain 4 absorption health, 30% speed, and Jump Boost III for 8 seconds. If damage taken would kill you but could have been prevented by this skill it will instead do so.

When this ability is triggered, an Elite mob within 8 blocks will glow for 6 seconds. Killing this glowing Elite will heal for 100% of your max health and cleanse any debuffs. If there are no Elite mobs then instead gain a regenerating effect that heals for 5% max health every second for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Skirmisher
skills.simpleDescription: Deal more damage if other mobs are nearby.
descriptions: When dealing melee damage to a mob that is targeting you and has at least one other mob within 2.5 blocks while holding two swords, deal + 1 + 10% final damage.
The damage bonus now also applies to mobs not targeting you, and the damage bonus is increased to 2 + 15% final damage done.
When you hit a mob while holding two swords, the nearest mob within 3 blocks takes 30% of the original attack's damage.

skills.name: Smokescreen
skills.simpleDescription: Weaken and slow nearby mobs.
descriptions: Press key.swapOffhand while holding two swords and sneaking to launch a projectile which releases a cloud of smoke, afflicting all mobs within 6 blocks with 8 seconds of 20% weaken and 20% slowness. Cooldown: 20s.
The weaken debuff is increased to 40% and the radius is increased to 8 blocks.

The smoke cloud will now deal 12 melee damage on impact and additionally leave a persistent cloud on the ground for 8 seconds after activating. Mobs in the cloud gain the debuffs for 8 seconds, pulsing every second.

skills.name: Vicious Combos
skills.simpleDescription: Killing mobs reduces cooldowns, and killing Elite mobs completely refreshes them.
descriptions: Passively, killing a mob refreshes the cooldown of your abilities by 1 second. Killing an Elite or Boss mob instead resets the cooldown of your abilities.
Killing a mob now refreshes your ability cooldowns by 2 seconds. Killing an Elite or Boss mob inflicts nearby mobs within 5 blocks with 15% weaken and 15% vulnerability for 5 seconds.
When an ability goes on cooldown, your next melee attack within 3 seconds deals 20% more melee damage and that ability's cooldown is refreshed by 1 second, prioritizing the last ability.

specSkills.name: Blade Dance
specSkills.simpleDescription: Damage nearby mobs and become immune to damage for a short time.
descriptions: Press key.drop while holding two swords to enter a defensive stance, parrying all attacks and becoming invulnerable for 0.75 seconds. Afterwards, deal 6 melee damage to mobs within 5 blocks and roots them for 2 seconds. Cooldown: 18s.
Damage is increased to 9 and root duration is increased to 2.5 seconds. Cooldown: 16s.

specSkills.name: Deadly Ronde
specSkills.simpleDescription: Damage nearby mobs when striking after casting an ability.
descriptions: After casting an ability, gain a stack of Deadly Ronde for 4 seconds, stacking up to 2 times. While Deadly Ronde is active, you gain 20% speed, and your next melee attack consumes a stack to fire a flurry of blades in a thin cone with a radius of 4.5 blocks, dealing 4 melee damage to mobs they hit. Ronde damage is reduced by 35%%, proportional to how far from fully charged your melee attack is.
Damage is increased to 6, and you can now have up to 3 stacks.

specSkills.name: Wind Walk
specSkills.simpleDescription: Dash forwards, stunning and levitating mobs along the path.
descriptions: Press key.swapOffhand while holding two swords and not sneaking to dash in the direction you are facing, stunning and levitating enemies for 2 seconds. Elites are not levitated. Charges: 2. Cooldown: 25s.
Casting this ability reduces the cooldown of all other abilities by 4 seconds. Cooldown: 20s.

specSkills.name: Bodkin Blitz
specSkills.simpleDescription: Teleport forward, gaining momentary stealth and bonus melee damage.
descriptions: Right click while holding two swords and sneaking to teleport 10 blocks forwards. Upon teleporting, you gain 1 second of Stealth and your next melee attack deals 7 bonus damage if your target is not focused on you. Charges: 2. Cooldown: 20s.
Range is increased to 14 blocks, Stealth duration is increased to 1.5 seconds, and bonus damage is increased to 14. Cooldown: 18s.

specSkills.name: Cloak And Dagger
specSkills.simpleDescription: Killing mobs grants cloak stacks, which can be consumed to enter Stealth and buff your next melee attack.
descriptions: Killing a mob grants 1 stack of cloak, up to 8 stacks. Elite kills and Boss "kills" grant 5 stacks (every 300 damage to them in R2; every 450 damage to them in R3 excluding damage from this skill). Press key.drop while holding two swords to spend all cloak stacks to gain 2.5 seconds of Stealth and (200% * X) melee damage on your next melee attack while in Stealth, where X is the number of stacks you had at activation. Performing a successful melee attack or switching from your held swords ends Stealth. You must have at least 4 stacks for activation.
The stack cap is increased to 12 and the melee damage is increased to (300% * X).

specSkills.name: Coup de Grace
specSkills.simpleDescription: Instantly kill mobs brought below a health threshold.
descriptions: If melee damage you deal brings a normal mob below 15% health or an Elite mob below 20% health, they die instantly.
The health threshold is increased to 20% for normal enemies and 30% for Elites.
Gain 50% of your % Projectile Damage as Class Attack Damage and 40% of your % Attack Damage as Class Projectile Damage.

skills.name: Hunting Companion
skills.simpleDescription: Summon a fox to help you fight and stun mobs.
descriptions: Press key.swapOffhand while holding a projectile weapon to summon a fox companion. The fox attacks the nearest mob within 32 blocks. The fox prioritizes the first enemy you hit with a projectile after summoning, which can be reapplied once that target dies. The fox deals damage equal to 20% of your mainhand's projectile damage, amplified by both melee and projectile damage from gear. Once per mob, the fox stuns upon attack for 2 seconds, except for elites and bosses. When a mob that was damaged by the fox dies, you heal 5% of your max health. The fox disappears after 12 seconds. Triggering while on cooldown will clear the specified target. If used while in water, an axolotl is spawned instead, and if used while in lava, a strider is spawned instead. Cooldown: 24s.
Damage is increased to 30% of your projectile damage and the stun time is increased to 3 seconds.

Also summon an invulnerable eagle companion (parrot). The eagle deals the same damage as the fox and targets similarly, although the two will always avoid targeting the same mob at once. The eagle can swoop towards its target. The eagle applies 20% weaken for 5 seconds instead of stunning, which can be reapplied on a mob. If used in water, a dolphin is spawned instead.

skills.name: Eagle Eye
skills.simpleDescription: Reveal nearby mobs, making them more vulnerable to attacks.
descriptions: Left click while sneaking to reveal all enemies within 24 blocks, giving them the glowing effect for 10 seconds. Affected enemies have 20% vulnerability. If a mob under the effect of Eagle Eye dies the cooldown of Eagle Eye is reduced by 2 seconds. Cooldown: 24s.
The vulnerability is increased to 35%.
Your first attack against every enemy affected by this ability will deal 35% extra damage.

skills.name: Wind Bomb
skills.simpleDescription: Throw a bomb that damages and launches mobs up in the air, weakening and slowing them.
descriptions: Press key.swapOffhand while holding a projectile weapon and sneaking to throw a projectile that, upon recast, or contact with the ground or an enemy, deals 40% of your projectile damage to mobs within 3 blocks and launches them into the air, giving them 20% weakness, 20% slowness, and Slow Falling for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15s.

The damage is increased to 50% of your projectile damage. Additionally, a hit dealt to an airborne enemy deals 20% more damage but the bonus damage can only be applied to the same enemy again if it has been hit by a Wind Bomb. Cooldown: 10s.

Your Wind Bomb no longer launches enemies, instead stunning them for 1 second. On detonation, generate a vortex that pulls mobs within 10 blocks toward the center for 3 seconds. The vortex applies all the effects of the unenhanced Wind Bomb, including airborne damage.

skills.simpleDescription: Gain increased projectile damage. Landing shots further increases damage.
descriptions: Your projectiles deal 15% more damage. Additionally, each enemy hit with a critical projectile gives you a stack of Sharpshooter, up to 4. Stacks decay after 5 seconds of not gaining a stack. Each stack increases the damage bonus by an additional 3%.
Your Sharpshooter's Max Stacks is increased to 8. The base projectile damage bonus is increased to 20%. Additionally, gain a 20% chance to not consume arrows.
The damage bonus is further increased by 1.5% per block of distance between you and the target, up to 16 blocks.

skills.simpleDescription: Melee deals increasing damage the more you melee enemies.
descriptions: Attacking an enemy with a fully charged valid melee weapon attack grants you a Swift Cuts stack with a maximum of 3 stacks. Every stack grants you 5% melee damage. Stacks decay by 1 after 5 seconds.
Maximum stacks increased to 6.
Additional effect applies while having maximum Swift Cuts stacks. Tactical Maneuver: -30% Cooldown, Whirling Blade: +30% Damage and Radius, Predator Strike: -20% Cooldown, Split Arrow: +1 Bounce

skills.name: Quickdraw
skills.simpleDescription: Instantly fire a held projectile weapon.
descriptions: Left click while holding a projectile weapon to instantly fire a damaging projectile that inherits your weapon's aspect enchants. This skill can only apply Recoil once before touching the ground. Damage is based on region: R1 = 11 / R2 = 17 / R3 = 22. Cooldown: 6s.
Cooldown: 3s.
Projectiles shot with this skill are given Piercing 1.

skills.name: Swiftness
skills.simpleDescription: Gain movement speed, attack speed, and increased jump height.
descriptions: Gain 20% movement speed when you are not inside a town and a passive 10% attack speed.
The attack speed is increased to 15% and gain Jump Boost III when you are not inside a town.
Breaking a spawner reduces the cooldown of all your skills by 5%.

skills.name: Volley
skills.simpleDescription: Fire a volley of projectiles in front of you.
descriptions: When you shoot a projectile while sneaking, you shoot a volley consisting of 7 projectiles instead. Only one arrow is consumed, and each projectile deals 30% bonus damage. Cooldown: 15s.
Increases the number of projectiles to 11 and enhances the damage bonus to 50%.
Volley now fires twice as many arrows in twice as wide an arc.

specSkills.name: Rending Razor
specSkills.simpleDescription: Throw a razor that embeds itself into a hit enemy. Recasting the skill returns the razor and damages enemies in its path.
descriptions: Right click while looking level to toss a spinning razor that travels 14 blocks and deals 14 projectile damage when it embeds itself into an enemy. The razor lasts for 2 seconds. If the enemy is still alive, recasting the skill rends the razor out of the enemy, pulling it slightly and dealing 20 projectile damage to it and all enemies that the razor passes through. Cooldown: 6s.
The razor's damage is increased to 16 for the impact and 24 for the rend. Additionally, all enemies damaged by the razor receive 20% slowness for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 5s.

specSkills.name: Whirling Blade
specSkills.simpleDescription: Damage, weaken, and knock nearby mobs back.
descriptions: Press key.swapOffhand to throw a whirling blade that circles around you, knocking back and dealing 9 melee damage to enemies it hits within a radius of 4 and inflicts 30% weakness and 20% slowness for 3 seconds. Charges: 2. Cooldown: 6s.
The damage is increased to 18 and also stun for 0.75 seconds.

specSkills.name: Tactical Maneuver
specSkills.simpleDescription: Dash forward and stun nearby mobs. While sneaking, dash backwards and knock away nearby mobs.
descriptions: Press key.drop while not sneaking to dash forward, dealing 14 damage to the first enemy hit, and stunning it and all enemies within 3 blocks for 1 second. Press key.drop while sneaking to leap backwards, dealing 8 damage to enemies within 3 blocks and knocking them away. Charges: 2. Cooldown: 10s.
Charges: 3. Cooldown: 8s.

specSkills.name: Pinning Shot
specSkills.simpleDescription: Shooting a mob for the first time roots and weakens it. Shooting it again damages it for a percentage of its maximum health.
descriptions: The first time you shoot a non-boss enemy, pin it for 2.5 seconds. Pinned enemies are afflicted with 100% slowness and 30% weaken (Bosses receive 30% slowness and no weaken). Shooting a pinned non-boss enemy deals 10% of its max health on top of regular damage and removes the pin. A mob cannot be pinned more than once. This ability cannot be triggered by Volleys initiated by Quickdraw.
Weaken increased to 60% and bonus damage increased to 20% max health.

specSkills.name: Split Arrow
specSkills.simpleDescription: Hitting a mob with a projectile deals part of the damage to a nearby mob.
descriptions: When you hit an enemy with a projectile, the next nearest enemy within 5 blocks takes 35% of the original arrow damage. This ability cannot be triggered by Volleys initiated by Quickdraw.
Damage to the second target is increased to 60% of the original arrow damage.

specSkills.name: Predator Strike
specSkills.simpleDescription: Upon activation, your next shot will travel instantly and deal more damage the further it travels.
descriptions: Press key.drop while holding a projectile weapon and sneaking to prime a Predator Strike that unprimes after 5 seconds. When you fire a critical projectile with a strike primed, it instantly travels up to 30 blocks in a straight line until it collides with an enemy or block. Enemies within 1.25 blocks of the impact receive 200% of your Projectile damage increased by 10% for every block of distance between you and the hit enemy (up to 12 blocks). The final damage an enemy receives is capped at 400 in Region 2 and 750 in Region 3. Cooldown: 18s.
The damage now increases by 15% for each block of distance (up to the same cap), and the final damage cap is doubled. Cooldown: 14s.

classPassive.name: Totemic Projection
descriptions: Recast a totem while on cooldown, or use a custom trigger, to fire a snowball that moves all active totems to where it lands within a 3 block radius. Charges: 2. Cooldown: 5s.

skills.name: Cleansing Totem
skills.simpleDescription: Summon a totem that heals and cleanses players over its duration.
descriptions: Press key.drop while sneaking to fire a projectile that summons a Cleansing Totem. Players within 6 blocks of this totem heal 4% max health per second. Duration: 8s. Cooldown: 30s.
Duration is increased to 12 seconds. Now additionally cleanses debuffs from players 2 times evenly throughout the duration.
Healing is increased by 1% max health. Healing done while at full health is now converted to absorption, up to 4 absorption health. Now cleanses debuffs on every pulse.

skills.simpleDescription: Increase your healing rate and empower your totems.
descriptions: Gain 10% increased healing from all sources innately. Other players in range of your totems gain 5% increased healing. Additionally, your totem damage is boosted by 10% if there is any player within its radius.
The base healing rate is increased to 20%. The totem damage boost is increased to 20%.
Casting a non-totem ability in range of a totem immediately refunds 15% of its total cooldown, capping at 2 seconds.

skills.name: Flame Totem
skills.simpleDescription: Summon a totem that incinerates mobs in an area.
descriptions: Right click while sneaking to fire a projectile that summons a Flame Totem with a 6 block radius. Every 1.5 seconds, so long as it is within your line of sight, the totem pulses with flames that do 3 magic damage to mobs also within your line of sight. Non-totem spells cast within the radius increase your Flame Totem damage by 0.5 until it expires, limited up to 4 times. Duration: 15s. Cooldown: 22s.
Radius increased to 7 blocks, and the damage is increased to 4. Mobs take 5% extra damage from your Flame Totem with each consecutive pulse of damage taken.

The bonus damage from non-totem abilities can now be gained up to 6 times. Mobs within the Flame Totem's radius take 20% more magic damage from your non-totem spells. The final pulse of your Flame Totem now also ignites mobs for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Interconnected Havoc
skills.simpleDescription: Forms lines between your active totems, dealing damage to mobs crossing those lines.
descriptions: Totems form a line between them with a maximum distance of 10 blocks. Mobs take 5 magic damage each second while intersecting a line.
Damage is increased to 7. Maximum distance is increased to 16 blocks.
Mobs are now knocked back from the player and stunned for 0.75 seconds when coming in contact with a line for the first time.

skills.name: Lightning Totem
skills.simpleDescription: Summon a totem that deals damage with your hits and shocks mobs.
descriptions: Left click while sneaking to fire a projectile that summons a Lightning Totem. Every 2.5 seconds, all non-Elite/Boss mobs within 7 blocks are Shocked, rooting them for 0.75 seconds. Additionally, fully charged [Melee / Projectile] strikes bring down lightning, doing 2 + [50% / 35%] of your base weapon damage as magic damage. Duration: 16s. Cooldown: 26s.
The totem's range is increased to 9 blocks, and the damage is increased to 3 + [65% / 45%] of your base weapon damage, or 3 + [80% / 55%] instead against elites, bosses, and full health mobs.

When a mob dies within range of your Lightning Totem, it spawns a lightning storm at the mob's location (unless the mob is already in an existing storm). The lightning storm deals 4 magic damage to all mobs within 2.5 blocks of the center every 1 second for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Chain Lightning
skills.simpleDescription: Flings lightning at mobs in a medium radius in front of you, bouncing between mobs and totems.
descriptions: Right click while not sneaking or Left click while holding a projectile weapon and not sneaking to cast a beam of lightning, bouncing between up to 3 mobs within line of sight of each other and within 6 blocks of the last target hit, dealing 2.5 + (0.25 * Skill Points) magic damage to each. The beam can also bounce to nearby totems without consuming a hit target. Charges: 2. Cooldown: 6s.
Damage is increased to 4 + (0.4 * Skill Points). Up to 5 mobs can now be targeted.

Each totem the beam bounces off of now instantly pulses its effects at 80% efficiency for damaging totems and 30% efficiency for non-damaging totems. These extra activations do not interact with the stacking buffs from consecutive pulses on Flame Totem. The base magic damage of Chain Lightning is also increased by 3.

skills.name: Earthen Tremor
skills.simpleDescription: Summons a earthen tremor on your location, dealing damage and knocking mobs up.
descriptions: Press key.swapOffhand while sneaking to summon an earthen tremor at your location that deals 8 magic damage to mobs in a radius of 7 blocks. Totems and mobs within the tremor are launched, totems dealing 5 magic damage in a 4 block radius of where they land. Launched mobs are also rooted in place for 2 seconds. Cooldown: 12s.
Damage is increased to 11 and totem slam damage is increased to 8. Cooldown: 10s.

Mobs damaged by the intial hit of Earthen Tremor are inflicted with Cursed Earth for 5 seconds. Damaging them with a [Melee / Projectile] attack deals [50% / 35%] of the base weapon damage as magic damage to all mobs within a 4 block radius. The effect is then cleared.

skills.name: Ignition Drive
skills.simpleDescription: Harness thunder and flames to launch forth, dealing damage and lighting mobs on fire.
descriptions: Press key.swapOffhand while not sneaking to launch forward, lighting mobs on fire and dealing 11 damage within 3 blocks of your launching and landing location. Harness thunder to stun up to 2 mobs you pass through for 1 second. Fall damage is negated until you hit the ground or until 10 seconds pass. Cooldown: 18s.
Damage is increased to 15, the damage range is increased to 4 blocks, the stun limit is increased to 3, and the launching power is increased by 25%. Cooldown: 15s.

Using Ignition Drive above 75% health will instantly refresh its cooldown by 25%. Using Ignition Drive while below 75% health will grant 25% magic damage for 5 seconds and stun mobs from the launch location for 2 seconds.

specSkills.name: Spiritual Combos
specSkills.simpleDescription: Stack up spiritual crystals by killing mobs to deal damage to nearby enemies.
descriptions: Gain a stack of spiritual crystals each time you kill a mob not with this ability. When you get 12 stacks, they reset, and the crystals lash out at mobs within 12 blocks. Every 0.6 seconds, a random mob is shot, dealing 10 magic damage, up to a total of 16 shots. The first shot will wait to be fired if there are no mobs in range, but subsequent shots will do nothing if there are no mobs to shoot. Stacks decay at a rate of 1 stack per 8 seconds. Additionally, gain 10% speed while spiritual crystals are firing.
Damage is increased to 14. The number of shots is increased to 20. Stack decay rate is reduced to 1 stack per 12 seconds.

specSkills.name: Whirlwind Totem
specSkills.simpleDescription: Summon a totem that provides cooldown reduction to players within its radius.
descriptions: Press key.drop while not sneaking to fire a projectile that summons a Whirlwind Totem. Every 2 seconds, players within 6 blocks of the totem have their cooldowns reduced by 2.5% (maximum 0.75 seconds). Cannot decrease the cooldown of this ability. Additionally, other totems existing during this totem's duration gain 25% duration. Duration: 10s. Cooldown: 26s.
Duration is increased to 14 seconds. Now additionally gives 15% speed to players within range.

specSkills.name: Totemic Consecration
specSkills.simpleDescription: Mark totems as Sacred, instantly dealing damage around them and protecting players within their range.
descriptions: Left click twice while not sneaking while looking at a totem to mark it as Sacred for the remainder of its duration. Marked totems will instantly deal 10 magic damage to all mobs within range, plus 1 extra damage per 2.5 seconds remaining on the totem. Sacred Totems grant every player in the radius 15% resistance, and will also grant a player in its radius 20% of their max health as absorption exactly once if they drop below 40% health, then lose its Sacred empowerment. Charges: 2. Cooldown: 20s.
The damage is increased to 13 and non-Elite/Boss mobs are silenced for 5 seconds when that damage is dealt. Additionally Sacred Totems gain a 15% boost to their radius. Cooldown: 16s.

specSkills.name: Spiritcatcher Orbs
specSkills.simpleDescription: Your totems burst into Spiritcatcher Orbs which bind to and debuff attacked mobs.
descriptions: On totem expiration or destruction, your totems will leave behind 3 Spiritcatcher Orbs that last for 12 seconds. Pick up Spiritcatcher Orbs to imbue your next attack with Spiritflame that lasts 4 seconds. While inflicted with Spiritflame, all mobs with the same name within 12 blocks take 5 magic damage per second. Spiritflame imbued attacks have their damage increased by 20%. You can hold up to 12 Spiritcatcher Orbs, and these decay after 8 seconds. Any player can pick up your Spiritcatcher Orbs on the ground and you will gain the effects. Breaking a spawner immediately collects all of your Spiritcatcher Orbs.

Spiritflame duration is increased to 6 seconds and damage is increased to 6. Mobs inflicted by Spiritflame take 10% more magic damage and are afflicted with a 20% weaken effect that applies to melee, projectile, magic, blast, and fire damage.

specSkills.name: Decayed Totem
specSkills.simpleDescription: Summons a totem, dealing damage and heavily slowing some of the mobs within range.
descriptions: Press key.drop while not sneaking to fire a projectile that summons a Decayed Totem. The totem anchors up to 3 targets within 8 blocks of the totem, dealing 5 magic damage every 1 second and inflicting 30% slowness. Additionally your Flame and Lightning Totems that exist during this totem's duration gain 1 bonus damage and 1.5 bonus damage respectively, applying if they do damage. Duration: 10s. Cooldown: 26s.
Damage is now dealt every 0.75 seconds, and the duration is increased to 12 seconds. Additionally the Flame and Lightning Totem damage bonuses are increased to 1.5 and 2.5 respectively.

specSkills.name: Devastation
specSkills.simpleDescription: Destroy your nearest totem, dealing massive damage within a medium radius.
descriptions: Left click twice while not sneaking to destroy the nearest totem, dealing 28 magic damage to mobs within 6 blocks of the totem, and knocking them away. The totem's cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds. Cooldown: 15s.

The damage is increased to 36 and the radius is increased to 8 blocks. Each totem also has unique effects on explosion.
Flame Totem: Gain a 15% damage bonus for 6s.
Lightning Totem: Strikes the mob with the most health for an additional 8 magic damage and stuns all mobs in range for 1.5s.
Cleansing Totem: Weakens mobs in range by 30% for 10s.
Decayed Totem: Increases your Devastation's damage by 6.
Killing an enemy while holding a scythe grants 10% damage reduction for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Amplifying Hex
skills.simpleDescription: Deal damage to mobs in front of you for each debuff they currently have.
descriptions: Left click while holding a scythe and sneaking to unleash a magic cone up to 8 blocks in front of you, dealing magic damage equal to 2 + (0.5 * Player Level, capped based on region: R1 Level 7 / R2 Level 14 / R3 Level 21) to each enemy for each debuff it has. Debuffs include, but are not limited to, Fire, Slowness, Weaken, Decay, Bleed, and more. Deal an additional 1 damage for each extra level of debuff above 1, capped at 2 extra levels per debuff. 20% Slowness, Decay 2, etc. count as level 2 debuffs. Cooldown: 10s.
Range increased to 10 blocks. The extra debuff level damage is increased to 2 per extra level, and the extra debuff level cap is increased to 3 extra levels.
For every 1% health you have above 80% of your max health, this ability deals 1.25% more damage and damages yourself by 1% max health.

skills.name: Phlegmatic Resolve
skills.simpleDescription: Gain resistance and knockback resistance for each ability on cooldown.
descriptions: For each ability on cooldown, gain 3% resistance and 10% knockback resistance, capped at 3 abilities.
Resistance is increased to 5% per ability on cooldown, and other players within 7 blocks are given 33% of your buffs from this ability.

All non-ailment damage taken is instead converted into a short Damage-over-Time effect. A third of the damage stored is dealt every second for 3 seconds. Each time this stored damage is dealt, deal 5% of the initial damage to all mobs within 3 blocks.

skills.name: Choleric Flames
skills.simpleDescription: Deal damage and ignite nearby mobs.
descriptions: Right click while holding a scythe and sneaking to deal 3 magic damage to mobs within 9 blocks, knocking them back and igniting them for 7 seconds. Cooldown: 10s.
The damage is increased to 5, and mobs are also afflicted with -100% healing for 7 (Counts as a level 1 debuff).

Mobs ignited by this ability are inflicted with an additional level of Inferno for every two debuffs they have (rounded down) prior to this ability, up to 2. Additionally, when these mobs die, they explode, applying all Inferno they have at the time of death to all mobs within 3 blocks for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Cursed Wound
skills.simpleDescription: Your attacks deal more damage for each ability on cooldown and apply damage over time.
descriptions: Attacking a mob with a critical scythe attack passively afflicts it and all mobs within 3 blocks around it with 1 magic damage every second for 6 seconds. Your melee scythe attacks passively deal 5% more damage per ability on cooldown, capped at 3 abilities.
Your melee scythe attacks now passively deal 10% more damage per ability on cooldown instead.

When you kill a mob with a melee scythe attack, all debuffs (excluding stuns and silences) on the mob get stored in your scythe. Then, on your next melee scythe attack, all mobs within 3 blocks of the target are inflicted with the effects stored in your scythe, as well as 3% of your melee attack's damage as magic damage per effect.

skills.name: Melancholic Lament
skills.simpleDescription: Weaken nearby mobs and force them to target you.
descriptions: Press key.swapOffhand while holding a scythe and sneaking to recite a haunting song, causing all mobs within 8 blocks to target you and afflicting them with 20% Weaken for 8 seconds. Cooldown: 16s.

The Weaken is increased to 30%. Players in the radius have their negative potion effect durations decreased by 10 seconds. Your next melee scythe attack within the next 4 seconds will silence all mobs within 3 blocks for 3 seconds.
For 8 seconds after casting this ability, you and other players within 16 blocks gain 2.5% melee damage for each mob targeting you in that radius (capped at 6 mobs).

skills.name: Grasping Claws
skills.simpleDescription: Fire a projectile that damages, pulls, and slows mobs.
descriptions: Press key.drop while holding a scythe or projectile weapon and sneaking to fire a projectile that pulls mobs within 8 blocks towards it once it makes contact with a mob or block. Pulled mobs are dealt 3 magic damage and afflicted with 20% slowness for 8 seconds. Cooldown: 16s.
Slowness is increased to 30%. After the projectile lands, your next melee scythe attack within 4 seconds will deal 4 + 30% of the attack’s damage as magic damage to all mobs within 3 blocks.

When the projectile lands, an impenetrable cage that lasts 6 seconds is summoned at its location. Mobs within 6 blocks of the center cannot enter or exit the cage, and players in the cage heal 5% max health healing every second. Mobs that are immune to crowd control cannot be trapped.

triggers.restriction: holding a scythe or projectile weapon

skills.name: Sanguine Harvest
skills.simpleDescription: Passively apply Bleed with your abilities. Activate to mark mobs, healing whoever kills them.
descriptions: Mobs you damage with a non-DoT ability are afflicted with 1 stack of Bleed. Right click while holding a scythe and not sneaking to fire a burst of darkness which travels up to 8 blocks. Upon reaching max range or contacting a block or mob, it explodes, knocking back all mobs within 4 blocks and applying a blood mark to them for 20 seconds. Any player that kills a marked mob is healed for 5% max health. Cooldown: 20s.
Healing from marked mobs is increased to 10% max health. Additionally, melee attacks against marked mobs heal the player for the full amount, deal 10% more damage, and consume the mark.

When cast, a 8 block cone of blight is created on the ground which lasts for 6 seconds. Mobs in the blighted area take 3% extra damage per debuff they currently have. Blight is not counted as a debuff.

skills.name: Soul Rend
skills.simpleDescription: Critical strikes heal you.
descriptions: When you attack a mob with a critical scythe attack, heal 5 health. Cooldown: 8s.

The attacked mob is marked for 8 seconds, causing your next 2 critical scythe attacks against them to heal you for 10% of the damage dealt, capped at 2.5 health per hit. Killing the mob heals you for 1.5 health for each remaining mark on the mob. Healing from this ability now applies to all players within 7 blocks of you.
Healing from the initial attack that is above max health or negated by Dark Pact is converted into up to 4 absorption health, which lasts 2.5 seconds.

specSkills.name: Dark Pact
specSkills.simpleDescription: Deal extra melee damage and gain absorption per kill at the cost of not being able to heal for a short period of time.
descriptions: Press key.drop while holding a scythe and not sneaking to cause a dark aura to form around you. For the next 7 seconds, your melee scythe attacks deal 50% more damage. Each kill during this time increases the duration of your aura by 1 second and gives 1 absorption health (up to 6) for the duration of the aura. However, you cannot heal for 7 seconds, and healing is reduced by 66.67% until the aura ends. You may retrigger this ability again after 7 seconds to cancel your pact. Cooldown: 14s.
The damage buff is increased to 75%, and your Soul Rend bypasses the healing prevention, healing you by 2/4 health, depending on the level of Soul Rend. Nearby players are still healed as normal.

specSkills.name: Judgement Chain
specSkills.simpleDescription: Teleport a mob to you and debuff it.
descriptions: Press key.swapOffhand while holding a scythe, not sneaking, and while looking at an unchained mob within 20 blocks to teleport them in front of you and chain them to you for 8 seconds, taunting them and afflicting them with 40% slowness and 40% weaken for 3 seconds. You deal 25% more damage to chained mobs. Bosses and crowd control/knockback immune mobs cannot be teleported, but will be chained and debuffed. Charges: 2. Cooldown: 12s.
Now additionally teleport and chain the 2 closest mobs within 3 blocks of the targeted mob, and you deal 50% more damage to chained mobs.

specSkills.name: Voodoo Bonds
specSkills.simpleDescription: Slash and fire a pin that curses mobs and protects players.
descriptions: Left click while holding a scythe and sprinting to slash in a small arc and fire a pin that travels 10 blocks. Mobs hit take 3 melee damage and are cursed for 8 seconds. When a cursed mob takes melee, projectile, or magic damage (except from this ability), all other cursed mobs within 4 blocks take 15% of the suffered damage. Critical melee hits against cursed mobs will spread it to 1 other un-cursed mob within 10 blocks. Players hit are bonded to you instead; the next hit they take within 8 seconds will be redirected to you based on the percentage of health that player would have lost, but cannot reduce your health below 1. Charges: 2. Cooldown: 10s.

The curse now deals 20% of taken damage, and it spreads to 2 other mobs on critical strikes. The slash and pin deal 9 additional damage to already-cursed mobs. Take 25% less damage when redirecting damage from other players.

specSkills.name: Haunting Shades
specSkills.simpleDescription: Place a Shade that debuffs nearby enemies with Vulnerability.
descriptions: Press key.swapOffhand while holding a scythe and not sneaking to conjure a Shade which lasts 7 seconds at the target block or mob location. Mobs within 6 blocks of a Shade are afflicted with 10% vulnerability. Cooldown: 10s.
Players within 6 blocks of the Shade are given 10% strength and heal 2.5% of their max health each second.

specSkills.name: Restless Souls
specSkills.simpleDescription: Mobs that die near you spawn a vex that targets enemies, dealing damage and silencing them.
descriptions: Whenever an enemy dies within 8 blocks of you, an invulnerable vex spawns. The vex targets mobs and possesses them, dealing 10 magic damage to the target and silences all mobs within 0.25 blocks for 2 seconds. Vex count is capped at 3 and each lasts for 15 seconds. Each vex can only possess 1 enemy. Enemies killed by the vex will not spawn additional vexes.

Damage is increased to 15 and silence duration increased to 3 seconds. Maximum vex count increased to 5. Additionally, the possessed mob is inflicted with a level 1 debuff of the corresponding active skill that is on cooldown for 4 seconds. Grasping Claws > 10% Slowness. Level 1 Choleric Flames > Set mobs on Fire. Level 2 Choleric Flames > -100% Healing. Melancholic Lament > 10% Weaken. Withering Gaze > Decay 1. Haunting Shades > 10% Vulnerability.

specSkills.name: Withering Gaze
specSkills.simpleDescription: Stun and deal damage over time to all mobs in front of you.
descriptions: Press key.drop while holding a scythe and not sneaking to unleash a 9 block long cone in the direction you are facing. Mobs in the cone are stunned for 3 seconds (elites and bosses are rooted instead) and dealt 1 magic damage every 0.5 seconds for 6 seconds. Cooldown: 30s.
The damage over time duration is increased to 8 seconds. Cooldown: 20s.
Gain 20% knockback resistance.

skills.name: Brute Force
skills.simpleDescription: Critical melee attacks deal extra damage and knock back nearby mobs.
descriptions: Performing a critical melee attack deals 2 damage and applies knockback to the hit enemy and all enemies within 2 blocks. Bosses do not take knockback.
The damage is increased to 2 plus 10% of the critical attack's damage.
Triggering this ability causes a subsequent wave after 0.5 seconds centered on the hit enemy that deals 75% of the damage and applies knockback.

skills.name: Counter Strike
skills.simpleDescription: Deal extra damage to a mob after taking damage from them.
descriptions: When a mob attacks you (even if the attack is blocked or negated), a Counter Strike is primed against that mob, which lasts up to 4 seconds. Hitting a mob with a Counter Strike deals 10% more damage and removes the Counter Strike.
Damage bonus is increased to 20% Additionally, the first time you taunt a given mob using an ability, a Counter Strike is primed against that mob.

Take 10% less damage from a mob that has a Counter Strike primed against them. If the Counter Strike was primed while you had absorption active, take 12.5% less damage instead, and gain 50% Knockback Resistance while the Counter Strike is active.

skills.name: Defensive Line
skills.simpleDescription: Increase resistance for you and surrounding players.
descriptions: Block while sneaking to grant yourself and other players within 8 blocks 20% resistance for 10 seconds. Additionally, mobs within 3 blocks of an affected player are knocked back. Cooldown: 30s.
The effect is increased to 30% resistance.
Additionally, all affected players negate the next melee attack dealt to them within the duration.

skills.simpleDescription: Killing mobs increases your speed and attack speed.
descriptions: Gain 30% attack speed for 5 seconds after killing a mob.
Attack speed is increased to 40% and also gain 20% speed for 5 seconds.
Additionally, your next melee swing within 5 seconds after getting a kill deals 20% extra damage.

skills.name: Riposte
skills.simpleDescription: While wielding a sword or axe, block a mob's melee attack to stun the mob or gain damage.
descriptions: While wielding a sword or axe, block an incoming melee attack. Cooldown: 15s.

Blocking a melee attack with Riposte's effect while holding a sword grants 100% extra damage on your next sword swing within 2 seconds. Blocking with Riposte's effect while holding an axe stuns the attacking mob for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 12s.
When Riposte activates, deal 15 melee damage to all mobs within 4 blocks and root them for 1.5 seconds.

skills.name: Shield Bash
skills.simpleDescription: Bash mobs with your shield, stunning and taunting them.
descriptions: Block while looking at a mob within 4 blocks and not sneaking to deal 8 melee damage, stun for 1 second, and taunt the targeted enemy. Elites and bosses are rooted instead of stunned. Cooldown: 8s.
Additionally, apply damage, stun, and taunt to all mobs within 3 blocks of the mob targeted by this ability.
Blocking damage with a shield within 1 second of beginning to block refreshes 50% of this ability's cooldown.

skills.simpleDescription: Increase your max health and resistance to ailment damage.
descriptions: Gain 10% max health and take 20% less damage from poison, wither, and drowning.
The max health is increased to 20% and the damage reduction is increased to 40%.
Gain an additional 5% max health. Additionally, when below 50% health, gain 20% healing.

skills.simpleDescription: Increase total damage dealt with axes and swords and gain resistance while holding a sword.
descriptions: You gain 10% resistance while holding a sword. Additionally, your axe damage is increased by an unscalable 2 plus 5% of final damage dealt.
Your sword swing's damage is increased by an unscalable 1 plus 10% of final damage dealt. The axe damage buffs are increased to an unscalable 4 plus 10%.
Gain 10% final damage when using either a sword or an axe. Apply 10% weaken for 4 seconds when using a sword. Gain 15% speed when holding an axe.

specPassive.name: Bloodlust
descriptions: Gain Bloodlust stacks upon dealing 70/120 melee damage, stacking up to 10. 33% of melee damage from AoE contribute towards Bloodlust. Passively gain 2 Bloodlust when out of combat.

specSkills.name: Glorious Battle
