specSkills.simpleDescription: Lunge forwards, dealing damage and empowering your next critical attack.
descriptions:
Press key.swapOffhand while not sneaking lunges you forward at a velocity of 1.5, granting knockback immunity (vertical velocity is capped at 0.3). While airborne, colliding with nearby mobs deal 5 melee damage. Critically attacking during Glorious Battle or 1.5s after landing causes a large overhead swing, dealing 75% weapon damage to the struck mob and 50% weapon damage to all other mobs within 2.5 blocks and knocks them back.  
 
 Cost: 2x Bloodlust Stack.
Glorious Battle now deals 8 melee damage on collision, 90% weapon damage to the struck mob, and 60% weapon damage to all other mobs. The vertical cap is removed.

specSkills.name: Meteor Slam
specSkills.simpleDescription: Swing your weapon to damage mobs and vault yourself upward. Passively generate a slam attack when fallen from great heights.
descriptions:
Press key.swapOffhand while sneaking vaults you upwards at a velocity of 1.1 (reduced by 50% until landing), dealing 10 melee damage within a 4 block cone and knocking mobs downwards. Falling more than 3 blocks generates a slam where you land, dealing 3.5 melee damage per block fallen with a radius of 3 blocks, capping at 7 blocks. Additional height will count 25% of the original value, slowly decreasing. Dealing any damage with Meteor Slam cancels all fall damage. 
 
 Cooldown: 5s.
 Cost: 1x Bloodlust Stack.

Sneaking (or Press key.swapOffhand if enabled) while midair now performs a ground pound attack, lunging you downward at a velocity of 1.8. Your next Meteor Slam is amplified: 
 - +1.5 damage per block fallen.
 - +1.5 block radius.
 - 5s of fire.
 - 15% slowness for 2s.
 - Knocks back mobs. 
 
 Cost: 1x Bloodlust Stack.

specSkills.name: Rampage
specSkills.simpleDescription: Consume Bloodlust stacks to knock enemies back, and gain health regeneration and melee damage on Bloodlust gain.
descriptions:
Right click while looking down to deal 6 melee damage and knocking all enemies back within a 4 block radius. For the next 3s, you gain 10% melee damage, and 1% max health regen per second. The next 3 Bloodlust stack extends the duration by 1s. The max duration is 6s. Rampage damage does not contribute towards Bloodlust. 
 
 Cost: 4x Bloodlust Stack.
Rampage now deals 10 damage, gain 15% melee damage, and gain 10% melee resistance. Additional, the next 0.25 Bloodlust stack will extend the duration and the max duration is now 8s.

specSkills.name: Bodyguard
specSkills.simpleDescription: Teleport to another player, giving them and yourself absorption and stunning nearby mobs.
descriptions: Left click twice while looking directly at another player within 25 blocks to charge to them. Upon arriving, knock away all mobs within 4 blocks. Both you and the other player gain 8 absorption health for 10 seconds. Left click twice while looking down to cast on yourself. Cooldown: 30s.
The absorption health is increased to 12. Additionally, affected mobs are stunned for 3 seconds.

specSkills.name: Challenge
specSkills.simpleDescription: Taunt nearby enemies and gain absorption and melee damage.
descriptions: Left click while sneaking to make all mobs within 14 blocks target you. You gain 1 absorption and 5% melee damage per affected mob (up to 4 absorption and 20% melee damage) for 10 seconds. Cooldown: 20s.

Gain 2 absorption and 7.5% melee damage per affected mob (up to 8 absorption and 30% melee damage) instead. For each taunted mob killed (up to 6), gain a stackable 4% speed for 10 seconds and reduce the cooldown of Guardian skills by 0.5 seconds.

specSkills.name: Shield Wall
specSkills.simpleDescription: Deploy a wall that can block projectiles and mobs from entering.
descriptions: Press key.swapOffhand while holding a shield in either hand to create a 180 degree arc of particles from 1 block below to 5 blocks above the user's location and with a 2.75 block radius in front of the user. Enemies that pass through the wall are dealt 3 melee damage and knocked back. The wall also blocks all nonmagical enemy projectiles. The wall lasts 6 seconds and moves along with the user. Triggering again while active makes the wall stationary at the same location for the remainder of the duration, with radius increased to 4 blocks. Cooldown: 25s.
The shield wall lasts 10 seconds instead. Cooldown: 18s.

triggers.restriction: holding a shield in either hand
holding a shield in either hand
holding a shield in either hand
